name: List Events
description: Get a list of event objects in the user's mailbox. [See the documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/user-list-events)

configurable_props.name: filter
configurable_props.label: Filter
configurable_props.description: Filters results. For example, `contains(subject, 'meet for lunch?')` will include events whose title contains ‘meet for lunch?’. [See documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/filter-query-parameter) for the full list of operations.

configurable_props.name: orderBy
configurable_props.label: Order By
configurable_props.description: Orders results. For example, `displayName desc` will sort the results by Display Name in decending order.

configurable_props.name: maxResults
configurable_props.label: Max Results
configurable_props.description: The maximum number of results to return
